claim: The owner, 2026-11-18: decoration laid on a conveyor belt (a pipe entrance's drain cover) is illogical; it belongs on the floor beside it. We take it further in Gravesend: a floor that travels (a conveyor, a lift, a rotating ride) carries no decoration that is meant to stay put.
evidence: the owner, 2026-11-18: 'there are few illogical things like that pipe entrance decoration on the conveyor belt instead on the floor' (projects/blood-city/level/dressing.py:175-177; bloodmap/sprite_fit.py:394-395)
use: Exclude movers from generic dressing passes; things that ride a mover are set carried (cstat 8192) on purpose.

checked.how: Found the words at projects/blood-city/level/dressing.py:175-179 and bloodmap/sprite_fit.py:394-395: the owner, 2026-11-18, 'there are few illogical things like that pipe entrance decoration on the conveyor belt instead on the floor, sometimes we have details like this missed'. dressing.py:174 skips any region that moves; sprite_fit.on_travelling_floor counts only pan+drag floors (conveyors), not water.
